MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

2. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 3
   D. 21

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

5. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

6. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

8. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

11. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 8
   C. 24.5
   D. 7

12. Solve for x: x + 8 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 15
   D. 8

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 169
   D. 26

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 21
   C. 30
   D. 90

16. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 1

17. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

18. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 1

19. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

20. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

21. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

22. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 34
   C. 66
   D. 17

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
